t: A programmable humanoid robot with 17 servos and a Raspberry Pi controller.
steps: Contact UBTECH for a quote and the course materials for Yanshee.
Ask IT to review the app and the robot's Wi-Fi use.
Install the Yanshee app from the App Store or the Android store.
Connect the robot and run a first Blockly program.
Move to Python on the Raspberry Pi with advanced students.
